# Taxonomy of Grid-Based Logic Games

## I. Cell Coloring & Shading
Games where the primary mechanic involves marking cells as shaded/unshaded or colored.

### A. Pure Shading
- Akari
- Hitori
- Kurodoko
- Nurikabe
- Nuritwin

### B. Shading with Constraints
- Heyawake
- Kurotto
- Norinori
- Nurimisaki
- Shakashaka
- Sto-stone

### C. Selective Coloring
- Choco Banana
- Double Choco
- Moon-or-Sun
- Usowan

## II. Path & Loop Drawing
Games where drawing continuous lines or loops is the primary mechanic.

### A. Closed Loops
- Dotchi-Loop
- Masyu
- Mid-loop
- Slitherlink

### B. Open Paths
- Hashiwokakero
- Hebi
- Numberlink
- Suraromu

### C. Complex Path Patterns
- Nagareru
- Ripple Effect
- Yajilin

## III. Polyomino Placement & Partitioning
Games involving dividing the grid into or filling it with connected regions.

### A. Free Polyomino Placement
- LITS
- Shikaku

### B. Polyomino Partitioning
- Evolomino
- Fillomino
- Five Cells
- Juosan
- Sashigane

### C. Polyomino Variants
- Chained Block
- Makaro
- Tilepaint

## IV. Constraint Satisfaction & Deduction
Games emphasizing logical deduction with numeric or symbolic constraints.

### A. Numeric Constraints
- Nansuke
- Nurimeizu
- Sudoku
- Yosenabe

### B. Pattern & Region Constraints
- Pencils
- Satogaeri
